verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Deel serves an llms.txt at developer.deel.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The docs also offer clean Markdown for any page by appending .md and point to a full documentation index, and many doc pages are cited as .md URLs, so agents can consume the docs directly. Missing for 10: the llms.txt body appears to contain stray HTML stylesheet markup rather than a clean curated index, there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific doc guidance, and there is no independent corroboration of agents using these docs successfully.
